scope: Local generic suspended vector export client, CLI and synthetic fixtures

checks.command: bun run test -- test/vector-export-client.test.ts test/vector-export-cli.test.ts test/vector-export.test.ts test/vector-export-state.test.ts
node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run test/vector-export-client.test.ts test/vector-export-cli.test.ts test/vector-export.test.ts test/vector-export-state.test.ts

verified: Local SnapshotReader index SHA/order/global digest and fixed-part digests checked before live execution.
Explicit original object ID and current revision required; initial/final control both require the same completed, suspended, quiescent state with pending=false/failures0 and no work or alarms.
Every vectors POST includes the suspension header and requires an exact echo; receipt hashes/counts/part digests agree with the normalized final manifest.
No automatic retry, redirect, credential refresh, run, resume or suspend call. URL userinfo/path/query/hash rejected, including empty userinfo.
Whole-request deadline covers fetch and body consumption, including a hanging injected transport/stream. Oversized/malformed/private responses do not propagate raw content.
Intent records are fsynced before requests; lost acknowledgement retains the exclusive failed journal and sends no later request. A new journal is required after separate review.
Existing or concurrently created local manifests are never overwritten; final control must pass before exclusive local manifest creation.
Actual Bun dry-run and injected credential getter prove no credential/transport path; privacy-safe outputs normalize unknown response fields.

Live export refuses missing/symlink/file/unowned/non-0700 journal parents before any credential getter or transport, leaving no journal ancestors. Existing private-parent success and all prior exclusive journal/manifest cases still pass.
limits: This is protocol/receipt validation and server-reported R2 readback, not independent download/hash verification of local vector bytes.
Vector positions, fingerprints, 768-dimensional shape and receipts do not attest the model that generated existing vectors.
No completed production or staging backup acquisition, publication, resource state or hosted quota/cost claim is established.
Full repository and fresh Linux CI gates remain parent-owned; corpus invariant artifact checks were skipped because those optional dist artifacts were absent.

amendments.scope: Reviewed P2 journal-parent durability prerequisite only

redProof.command: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run test/vector-export-cli.test.ts --testNamePattern 'missing journal parent'

amendments.newPrerequisite: Journal parent must already exist, be a non-symlink directory owned by process.getuid(), with mode0700. CLI creates no parent/ancestor. Operator must supply a durable existing private path.
